mechanism: Primaquine can cause hemolytic anemia through oxidative stress, which may be exacerbated in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency; pioglitazone increases insulin sensitivity and may mask metabolic complications of hemolysis.
action: Screen for G6PD deficiency before primaquine use; monitor hemoglobin, hematocrit, and reticulocyte count regularly; assess for signs of hemolysis (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue); use lowest effective primaquine dose.
